name: diode_fixture
description: VIN=5V through D1 → MID → R1(10k) → GND. Diode is forward-biased; V(MID) sits at VIN - V_F.

MID.rationale: Series diode drop. Generic D_GENERIC model (IS=1e-14, N=1) has V_F ≈ 0.65V at ~0.44mA operating current, so V(MID) = 5.0 - 0.65 ≈ 4.35V. Tolerance covers the V_F spread across the operating range.
